passage:
Every year, students in our school join a speaking contest. The best speakers usually have loud voices and big smiles.
This year, a quiet student named Grace joined. Some classmates were surprised because Grace almost never spoke in class.
On contest day, Grace's voice was not loud, but it was clear. She spoke slowly, and every word was easy to understand. Her story was about learning to talk to her sick grandfather.
She did not win first place, but many people remembered her speech.
After the contest, Grace said she still did not like standing on stage. But she was glad she tried.
A strong voice does not always need to be loud. Sometimes it only needs to be honest.
